summary_en: OTAKE updated its capital cost and stock price-conscious management strategy under the Second Medium-Term Management Plan, disclosing revised targets and progress as of October 2026.
title_en: Response toward Realization of Management Conscious of Cost of Capital and Stock Price (Update)
translation_en_brief:
OTAKE Corporation announced on October 27, 2026, an update to its capital cost and stock price-conscious management initiative, which was initially unveiled on July 12, 2024, as part of its Second Medium-Term Management Plan. The update reflects the company's current analysis and evaluation of progress made to date.

The disclosure included financial metrics showing the company's performance trajectory from fiscal year 2022 through 2026. As of May 2025, OTAKE transitioned to consolidated financial reporting. Key metrics reveal that ROE declined from 5.8% in fiscal 2024 to 5.1% in fiscal 2025 and 5.3% in fiscal 2026, while PBR improved to 0.40 from 0.45. The dividend per share increased to 40 yen in fiscal 2025 and 2026, maintaining a dividend payout ratio around 17-18%. The company's emphasis remains on balancing capital efficiency with shareholder returns while narrowing the gap between book value and market valuation.

The attached material to this announcement contains the detailed revised targets and strategic initiatives aligned with the company's capital cost awareness objectives.
